items.title: HAI QASD KUCH FAZAEL-E BAQUAR RAQAM KAROON
items.body:
hai qasd kuch fazael-e baquar raqam karoo'n
tahreer mojizaate imam-e umam karoo'n
likhne me misle qaama-e sar ajz qam karoo'n
loho qalam ko gheerate loho qalam karoo'n
<<MINI>>
anwaare mojizaat se raushan kitaab ho
khaama shuaa ho toh waraq e aaftaab ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din pidar ki godh me tha woh falak maqaam
ek shia laya nazre dirham paye imaam
sajjad ke huzoor woh dirham rakhe tamaam
dirham se khelne lagaa farzand-e nekh naam
<<MINI>>
kya aql di thi khaaliq-e roz-e hisaab ne
dirham zamee'n pe phaink diya us janaab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
tab doudh kar mohib ne wo dirham utha liya aur us ko darmiyaan-e dirham phir milaa diya
baquar ne chunke phir wahi dirham judaa kiya
tifli me thi ye aap pe taaeed-e kibriyaa
likha hai teen baar yehi maajra huva
us dam mohib ko sheh ke tahayyur bada huva
<<DIVIDER>>
abid se ki ye shia-e abid ne iltejaa
irshaad aap kijiye ye maajra hai kya
sheh ne kaha ye aadat-e tifli na jaan'na
hoga imaam baad hamare ye mehlaqaa
dirham ye ek ghazbi-o maal-e haraam hai kyu'n kar ise qubool kare ye imaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baquar pe woh nisaar hua paau choom choom
tifli se sheh ke ilm-e khuda daad ki thi dhoom
baquar ki sharah karte hai ye khaas aur umoom
yaani hai woh imam shigafindah-e uloom
<<MINI>>
tha koi raaz-e ghaib na sheh se chupaa hua
uqdaa woh kaun tha jo na hazrat se waa hua
<<DIVIDER>>
likhta hu ab shahadat-e maula-e khoosh nihaad
tha bas ke zaid ibn-e hassan ko hasad ziyaad
rakhta tha bughz aap se wo baani -e fasaad
karta tha majliso'n me hiqaarat se sheh ko yaad
<<MINI>>
tha munharif woh baquar-e aali muqaam se
karta tha id'duae imamat imaam se
<<DIVIDER>>
sougand khaa ke zaid ne is waqt ye kahaa
daawaa na ab karoonga imamat ka mutleqaa phir sooe mulk e shaam wo mal'oo'n rawaa'n hua
abdul malik se jaake kahaa sab ye maajraa
aakhir ko ye kaha ke hamaare gumaan me
baquar sa ab nahi'n koyi saare jahaan me
<<DIVIDER>>
abdul malik ko bughz-o khusumat hui ziyaad
kya kya na usne shahe umam se kiye fisaad
akhir imam ko ye likhaa az rahe anaad
mai bhejtaa hoon zaid ko aye shahe khush nihaad
<<MINI>>
ibne hassan ko laayeq-e takreem kijiye
taadeeb kijiye use taaleem kijiye
<<DIVIDER>>
aur ek zeen taabiye jis me kiya tha sam
hum raahe zaid bhejaa baraaye shahe umam
aaya jo zaid rubaru-e shaahe ba karam
shah bole hai jo qasd tera jaante hai hum
<<MINI>>
aye ibne amm ye zulmo sitam tu ne kya kiya
is zeen me hai taabiye zehr-e dagha kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
is zeen par mai hota hu daanista ab sawaar
bande ko kya mashiyat-e eezad me eqtiyaar
baandha wo zeen asp pe allah re inkesaar aur zeb-e raahwaar hua shaahe ba weqaar
maut apni pasand ki raza-e ilaah me
us zaher ne nafooz kiya jism-e shah me
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne muraaje-at ki sawaari se aah jab
bas aashkaar hogaye aasaar-e maut sab
farmaaya teen roz ke hum mehmaa'n hai ab
jaffar ko laao aur kafan bhi karo talab
<<MINI>>
talib kafan ke badle hai is pairahan ke hum
kaabe ka tawaaf karte the jis ko pahen ke hum
<<DIVIDER>>
laaye wo jaama hazrat-e sadiq bachashm-e tarr
hazrat ne pyaar karke kahaa unko aye pisar
jaata hoo'n mai jahaa'n se tu hotaa hai bepidar
duniya se aaj kartaa hoo'n uqbaa ka mai safar
<<MINI>>
pyare pidar ke marne ka tum gham na khaaiyo
mazloomi-e hussain pe aansoo bhaaiyo

items.title: SAR PEETO AAJ MOOSA-E JAAFAR HUWA SHAHEED
items.body:
sar peeto aaj moosiye jaafar huwa shaheed
ibn-e ali-o ibn-e payambar huwa shaheed
ghurbat me aah kaazim-e bepar huwa shaheed
lo momino'n ka saathwaa'n rehbar huwa shaheed
<<MINI>>
pilwaaya zaher baade shah-e qaaso aam ko
haaroon na rasheed ne maara imaam ko
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se bayaa'n karu zulme ahle kee'n
afsos pet bhar kabhi khaana mila nahi'n
faaqe pe faaqe karta tha ahmed ka jaanashi'n
zindaa'n me choudaa saal the mahboob-e shaah-e dee'n
<<MINI>>
taaqat na thi zaraa bhi qaood-o qiyaam ki
haalat ye thi imaam alailhis salam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
di ummat-e nabi ko na hazrat ne badd duaa
har waqt sheh ke lab pe raha shukr-e kibriyaa
sindi ke taaziyaanou'n ki har roz thi jafaa
behta tha qoon jism se roohi lakal fidaa
<<MINI>>
eezaa-e qaid aisi kisi ne sahi nahi
bedaad is tarha ki kisi par huwi nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
al qissa zaher aap ko angoor me diya
jis se janaab-e moosa-e kaazim ne ki qazaa
baazo'n ne likha hai ye shahadat ka maajra
pighlaake sheesh aapko jabran pilaa diya
<<MINI>>
kaise kahu ke haal huwa kya imaam ka
jalkar huwa kabaab kaleja imaam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul padh gaya ke moosiye kaazim ne ki qazaa
laashe ko laake jasr pe aada ne rakh diya aur chehra-e imaam se kapda hataa diya
do roz yu hi laash ka chehra khula raha
thi laash bekafan shah-e aali maqaam ki
touqeer thi ye aal-e rasool-e anaam ki
<<DIVIDER>>
nazdeek bhai tha na pisar tha, na bhaanja
tanhayi me ye zulm-o sitam waa musibataa
do roz tak to jasr pe laasha pada raha
mayyat pe rone waala bhi hai hai koi na thaa
<<MINI>>
sadme uthaake haye jahaa'n se guzar gaye
ghurbat me aah kaazim-e zeeshaan margaye
<<DIVIDER>>
shia nisaar aap ki ghurbat ke yaa imaam
ghurbat me tum shaheed huwe aye shah -e anaam
be jurm maara aap ko ya shah-e qaas-o aam
haaroon ne haif kardiya kaam aap ka tamaam
<<MINI>>
qouf-e quda na qouf-e rasool-e quda kiya
shamme hayaat aapki zaalim bujhaa diya
<<DIVIDER>>
misl-e tamaashaa dekhthe hai saare mard-o zan
hai zer-e aaftaab imaam-e huda ka tan
haaroo'n ka bhaai laash pe aaya basad mehan
hazrat ko apne ghar se diya qeemti kafan
kaazim ke paas bhejaa quda ne fidaayi ko lekin kafan mila na shahe karbalai ko

items.title: SHORA JAHAAN ME HASSAN-E ASKARI KA HAI
items.body:
shora jahaan me hassan-e askari ka hai
naqsha nagee'n ye arsh ki angushtari ka hai
kounain me ye gul chaman-e hyderi ka hai
durr-e yateem maadan-e paighambari ka hai
mazlumiyat misaale janaab-e hussain hai aur dabdabe me faatahe badr-o hunain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
par motemad ne qehr kiya waa musibata
aise wali ko zehar diya waa musibata
imaa'n ke ghar ko loot liya waa musibata
qoone jigar haram ne piya waa musibata
<<MINI>>
phaada kafan nabi ne ali nange sar huwe
bachpan me haye mahdi-e dee'n be pidar huwe
<<DIVIDER>>
arwaahe panjetan ko sataaya hazaar haif
jannat me mustafa ko rulaaya hazaar haif
turbat se fatima ko uthaaya hazaar haif
qabr-e shah-e najaf ko hilaaya hazaar haif
<<MINI>>
ghul saamere me hota tha jis waqt bain ka
yaa'n karbala me hilta tha marqad hussain ka
<<DIVIDER>>
hairaa'n the zaayeraan-e hussaini ke kya hai aaj kyu zalzale me qabr-e shah-e karbala hai aaj
mehshar miyaane ganj-e shaheedaa'n bapaa hai aaj
aati hai ye sadaa hame sadma badaa hai aaj
zaqmi badan ko mere adoo ne hilaa diya
pote ko mere zehre halahal pilaa diya
<<DIVIDER>>
hairat hai kyu zamee'n pe na arshe ulaa giraa
is zulm se ammaama-e mushkil kushaa giraa
abbasiyo'n pe kyu na falak jaabajaa giraa
baalaa-e qaak taaj-e rasoole quda giraa
<<MINI>>
sar apna khole sog me aal-e rasool ne
jannat me sar se phaink di chaadar batool ne
<<DIVIDER>>
likha hai jab imaam huwe aazim-e jinaa'n
ek dafaa saamere me qayaamat huwi ayaa'n
doulat saraa-e shaah se aane lagi fughaa'n
lo momino yateem huwe saaheb-uz zamaa'n
sar garm zulm chaaro'n taraf bad qisaal hai aur haif hai ke mahdi-e dee'n qurd saal hai
<<DIVIDER>>
saaya na baap ka na koi bhaai saath hai
sar par imaam-e asr ke bas haq ki zaat hai
is bepidar ki simt kise iltefaat hai
ab sharm ehle bait ki zahra ke haath hai
<<MINI>>
laashe ke gird shor jo nouhe ka hota tha
masoom phoot phoot ke baba ko rota tha
<<DIVIDER>>
ab is tarha se ehle qabar karte hai bayaa'n
maatam saraa me bibiyaa'n karti thi ye fughaa'n
nehla chuke jo laasha-e moulaa-e do jahaa'n
kafnaaya usko raqte mutahir ke darmiyaa'n
<<MINI>>
aawaaz aayi fatima ke shor-o shain ki
sab shiyaa roye bekafani par hussain ki

items.title: KIS UMR ME ALI-E NAQI BE PIDAR HUWE
items.body:
kis umr me ali un naqi be pidar huwe
bachpan me dil pe chot lagi nouhagar huwe
yasrab me jaanasheen-e shahe behrobar huwe
ye waaris-e bizaa-ate qairul bashar huwe
<<MINI>>
ilm-o amal ko maan liya sheq-o shaab ne
kya kamsini me paayi buzurgi janaab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
charqe neham imaam-e deham ka maqaam hai
pushto panaah arsh-e baree'n inka naam hai
har chaar simt mad'ha o sanaa-e imaam hai
tasbeeh sash jahat ki durood-o salaam hai
<<MINI>>
naari hai jo kahe ke ye noore quda nahi
anwaar qamsaa-e najbaa se judaa nahi
<<DIVIDER>>
aye door-e charq-e raah ye kaisa hai intezaam
qaamosh kyu'n rahoo'n ke shikaayat ka hai maqaam
rehne na paaye chain se is tarha se imaam
qayam maqaam iske huve dushmane imaam
<<MINI>>
farzand par rasool ke ummat jafaa kare
pursaa na jab koi ho to mazloom kya kare
<<DIVIDER>>
tayyar qatl par mutawakkil raha madaam
majboor rehgaya wo adu-e shah-e anaam
pahoncha safar me chod ke ye kaarina tamaam
qaayam maqaam uske huwe dushman-e imaam
<<MINI>>
fursat mili na dilbare sher-e ilaah ko
tadbeer motemad se mila zehr shaah ko
<<DIVIDER>>
wo qalq ka maseeh huwa saheb e firaash
be hiss tha jism farsh pe goya padi thi laash
kunj-e lahad ki gosha nashee'n ko huwi talaash
suraaq dil me tha toh kaleja tha paash paash
<<MINI>>
aate the haal dekhne baashinde shehar ke
pota raza ka marta tha sadme se zaher ke
<<DIVIDER>>
raavi bahut se haashmi is ke hai la kalaam
jin me hai ek ka hasan ibn-e hussain naam
aaya jo roz rehlat-e shaahe falak maqaam
sehne makaa'n me farsh pe the jalwagar imaam
<<MINI>>
majma bahut tha syed-e zeejaah ke qareeb
mardam the jamma ek sad-o panjaah ke qareeb
<<DIVIDER>>
nagaah askari nazar aaye hame udaas
dakhil huve makaa'n me ayaa'n chehre se thi yaas
paband hazn chaak gareebaan o be hawaas
dahni taraf khade huve aakar pidar ke paas
<<MINI>>
kis haal me hai koun ye hai jaante na the
huzzaar-e anjuman inhe pehchaante na the
<<DIVIDER>>
noor-e nazar ko dekh ke hazrat ne ye kaha
kar shukr kirdegaar ka aye mere mehlaqaa
haadas ek amr tere liye haq ne hai kiya
rone laga ye sunte hi wo raaziye raza
<<MINI>>
bola ke shukr marhamat-e zuljalaal hai
de apni nemate'n ye quda se sawaal hai
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha kisi ne tab huwa maaloom sab ko haal
ye hai hassan janaab-e ali un naqi ke laal
zaaher huwa jo umr ki jaanib kiya qayaal
hoga qareeb bees baras ka ye qush jamaal
<<MINI>>
samjhe ishaara ham ye kalaam-e imaam ka
hai jaanashee'n yehi shah-e aali maqaam ka
<<DIVIDER>>
rota raha wasi-e shahinshaah-e behrobar
saa-at wo aayi sar se uthaa saaya-e pidar
ab saamere se hota jaha'n ki taraf safar
hai hai chuta musaafir-e yasrab se ye bhi ghar
<<MINI>>
ghul padh gaya wafaate ghareebul watan huwi
saamaan ghusl ka huwa fikr-e kafan huwi

items.title: KYA HAAL HO RAZAA KE JIGAR BAND KA BAYAAN
items.body:
ibn-e raza bhi saalike raahe raza rahaa
sajjada-e rasool pe shaghle dua rahaa
har ranj me zabaan pa shukr-e khuda rahaa
ginti ke dostdaar the dushman hazaarhaa
<<MINI>>
badh khwaah kitne is qamar-e murtuza ke the
tha ek chiraagh sainkdo jhonke hawa ke the
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal ho razaa ke jigar band ka bayaa'n
pyaara tha murtuza ka wo sultan-e ins-o jaa'n
moujiz numa imaam-e zama'n haadiye jahaa'n
aise wali ke dar paye eezaa the badh-gumaa'n
<<MINI>>
souz-e alam se dil me the chaale pade huwe
the rashke gul ko jaan ke laale pade huwe
<<DIVIDER>>

bheja payaam chodiye ghar aayiye udhar

li karwate'n ali-o wali ko pukaar ke
eezaa-e paak sooj gaye dil figaar ke

kyu peer e charq jaaye taa saf hai ya nahi

anjaam is tarha bhi kitaabo'n me hai raqam

seeno'n ko apne qasta jigar peetne lage

items.title: Mushkil Kusha E Khalq Khudaara Madad Karo
items.body:
Mushkil Kusha E Khalq Khudaara Madad Karo
Mushkil kusha e khalq kudaara madad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab pukaarthi hai ke baba madad karo
Lashkar huwa tamaam nahl kol jaan nisaar
Narghe me zaallmoun ke hai zehra ka gul e zaar
Bekas pe toot padhthe hain laakhoun jafaa sheyaar
Bahre madad ab aalye ya shaah-e- zulfeqaar
<<MINI>>
Mushkil kusha e khalq kudaara madad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Zaqmoun se choor hai mere bhaai Ka sab badan
Ab dagmagaa rahe hain faras par shah e zaman
Hum shkil mustafa hain na aur qasim-e-hassan
Shaane kataa e sote hain abbas-e-saf shikan
<<MINI>>
Mushkil kusha e khalq kudaara madad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Beti tumhaari kya kare is waqt yaa ali
Girta hai kol dam me faras se mera aaqi
Mazloom bhaai tak na bahan ran me jaa saki
Abbas jaagthe nahi kab se jagaa chuki
<<MINI>>
Mushkil kusha e khalq kudaara madad karo
<<DIVIDER>>
Baba zameen e karbobala khoon se laal hal
Baba hazaaroun teghoun me amma ka laal hai
Baba sambhaal lo ke hussain ab nidhaal hai
Baba tumhaari beti ka adna sawaal hai
<<MINI>>
